judges.name: GithubClaimLease Pagination Completeness Judge
judges.invariant: listComments MUST observe all relevant post-boundary comments regardless of issue comment thread depth.
judges.tested_scenario: Thread has 100 comments on page 1, boundary marker at comment 101, competing claims at 102 and 103
judges.physical_result: listComments queries only ?per_page=100 and parses page 1 alone. No pagination follow-up or Link header parsing exists. Comments 101, 102, 103 are omitted.

judges.name: GithubClaimWindow Mutual Exclusion Judge
judges.invariant: Between two concurrent racing claims, at most one can return Acquired and all others must return Held.
judges.tested_scenario: Two concurrent instances A and B post claims 102 and 103 beyond page 1
judges.physical_result: Because neither claim appears in the truncated page 1 window, winnerAgainst(ownCommentId) returns Optional.empty() for both instances. Both instances fall back to winnerId = ownCommentId and return ClaimResult.Acquired. Neither instance yields or deletes its comment.
